rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone is impatient because they are eager or anxious for something to happen.

example.english: I impatiently waited for the email reply.
example.traditional: 我心急咁等住個電郵回覆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 gam3 dang2 zyu6 go3 din6 jau4 wui4 fuk1

rows.note: Use this instead when the impatience is irritated, restless, or showing that the person does not want to wait.

example.english: They impatiently knocked on the counter.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔耐煩咁喺櫃檯前面敲枱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 noi6 faan4 gam3 hai2 gwai6 toi2 cin4 min6 haau1 toi2
